title: Static finite-support multi-character double-commutator envelope
question: Can the static single-character estimate be extended to a fixed finite-support configuration character with an explicit support-size envelope?
decision_reason: For commuting distinct-site momentum shifts and configuration-local force functions, the kinetic and force seminorms admit explicit support-size and l1-amplitude bounds. The two independent arithmetic lanes and Lean R253 verify the fixture while preserving the product-density and history firewalls.
method: Write the finite-support character as one exponential of a commuting configuration sum and derive the multi-site CCR split.
Apply the scalar fourth-power inequality to the commuting shifted momenta and the L2 triangle inequality to the configuration force sum.
Reuse the registered static force fourth-moment and onsite fifth-moment authorities without changing their scopes.
Run SymPy, Fraction-only and Lean R253 checks with explicit support and amplitude costs.
finding: For support size two and amplitudes (1/4,-1/3), the kinetic squared envelope is 1341774241/53747712, the force squared envelope is at most 287875, and the conservative full squared envelope is 293764. The result is static and finite-support only.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite-support static bound only. It does not prove support-uniform product/core density, split-history uniformity, direct D or delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion independence, group law, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A.

adversarial_review.check: Cross-site shifted momenta commute and the exact split is kept on the polynomial core.
The |S|^3 and l1-amplitude costs are explicit.
Configuration locality preserves both two-sided force orientations.
Only the registered compact-source force input is reused.
No orthogonality between kinetic and force terms is assumed.
Static multi-character control is not promoted to split histories.
R253 checks rational fixture arithmetic only.
Product density, direct D/delta-D, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

qft_interface.closed: A fixed finite-support multi-character has an explicit static two-sided Gibbs-seminorm envelope in the registered finite periodic compact-source scope.
qft_interface.open: Support-uniform product/core density, evolved-force history control, direct D/delta-D Cauchy, exhaustion, common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.
